messages:
Emma: Quick QBR ask — we have a small SI co-sell microgrant pool (partner marketing funds) to route during next week's QBR. Who's owning approvals for APAC execs? Need finalization by EOD Wed.
Jay: I can own APAC approvals this cycle. Do we have the acceptance criteria?
Emma: Thanks Jay. Criteria: partner must be tier 2+; commit to joint demo; 3 month pipeline target >= $50k; and a co-marketing plan.
Sarah: Can we relax pipeline to $30k for first-time SI pilots? Many promising SIs are early-stage.
Lee: +1 to Sarah. Helps seed new integrations. Proposal: Tier2 with pipeline >=30k OR Tier3 with strong vertical fit + exec sponsor.
Emma: OK noted. Also posting an allocation snapshot to make numbers explicit:
```
Total pool: $120,000
SI microgrant allocation (target): 85% = $102,000
Marketplace joint-announce reserve: 15% = $18,000
```
Emma: @announce-bot can you post the updated rubric to the QBR doc and ping partner-ops?
announce-bot: Posted update to docs: https://redwood.atlassian.org/qbr/partner-funds — 'SI microgrant routing' section added.
Jay: I'll draft the approval email/template. Putting a first pass in /drive/partnerships/QBR-microgrant-template.docx and will ping for review.
Sarah: Timeline check — if approvals close Wed EOD, finance needs PO by Fri COB. Can we hit that?
Emma: Yes. I'll run the candidate list tomorrow morning and tag approvers (APAC execs + Jay).
Lee: Small ask — can we explicitly reserve 15% of the pool for marketplace joint-announces to avoid conflict with SI spend?
Emma: Good call. I'll earmark 15% and surface the split in the QBR slide deck (slide 6).
Jay: Thanks team. I'll share the draft approval thread once template is ready. :thumbsup:
